Subject: Annual governance orientation & decision calendar

Team —

I'm kicking off a short orientation and decision calendar to get us aligned for annual planning / QBR prep. The objective is narrow: agree governance, owners, scenario buckets, and a compact decision calendar so the SLT can sign off in early May.

High level asks (please read attachments first):
- Review the attached planning brief (Annual_Planning_Orientation.pdf) — I captured proposed governance roles and three scenario buckets (Base / Downside / Upside).
- Confirm owners for the three scenario streams (modeling, ops capacity, revenue assumptions) by end of day Thu Apr 22.
- We need the finance model (first pass) by EOD Fri Apr 29 for an SLT pre-read the week of May 3.
- Proposed orientation workshop: Thu Apr 28, 9–11am PT (remote). Please confirm availability.

Proposed owners (draft):
- Modeling / revenue assumptions: Marissa Cole
- Ops capacity & runbooks: Karthik Iyer + Jonas Weber
- Cost / unit economics scenarios: Markus Klein

Quick timeline (working):
- Apr 21–22: owners confirmed & folder created
- Apr 23–29: scenario details + finance model first pass
- May 3–6: SLT pre-read & dry-run
- May 10–14: QBR week & exec sign-off

Notes: We'll keep the orientation tight — agenda in the doc. If you have objections to owners above, reply with suggested changes.

Attachments: [Attachment: Annual_Planning_Orientation.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

Thanks —
Mina

Thanks Mina — good, tight framing. I support the proposed owners with one addition: we should explicitly own "cost-per-inference" and tail-latency tradeoffs as a scenario metric (this is what engineering cares about in production economics). Markus, can you take point on the cost scenarios and produce 3 simple levers (batching, quantization, routing) by Apr 27?

Marissa — can you own the revenue assumptions and produce a baseline ARR bridge + two downside cases by Apr 29? Finance partner should be looped for runway assumptions — I'll ask legal/finance to join if we need contract-level inputs.

I confirm Apr 28 9–11am PT for the workshop unless anyone objects.
